summary_definitions: rod_open_free = free name search reachable with no login/payment (open or simple disclaimer click). rod_walled = login, CAPTCHA, payment or block in front of the index (free-account logins count as walled because we may not create accounts). images_free = document images free AND reachable without login. legal_description_online = legal description readable free either in an open ROD index or in a free GIS field. index_back_to_before_1980 = earliest online index year stated by the portal is before 1980 (any open or walled portal).
